title: Compatibility of cyclic coefficient pullback comparisons
statement: theorem cyclicCoefficientPullbackCompatibility {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (h : Y ⟶ X) (e q : ℕ) (W V : X.Etale) (v : V ⟶ W) (x : Sheaf.H ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (pullback.fst h W.hom)).obj (Y.constantZMod e)) q) : let g := pullback.map h V.hom h W.hom (𝟙 Y) v.left (𝟙 X) (by simp) (by simp) let i := upperStarComp AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} g (pullback.fst h W.hom) (pullback.fst h V.hom) (by simp [g]) Sheaf.H.map ((Scheme.upperStarConstantSheafIso AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} g).app (AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift (ZMod e)))).hom q (cohomologyMap g _ q (Sheaf.H.map ((Scheme.upperStarConstantSheafIso AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (pullback.fst h W.hom)).app (AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift (ZMod e)))).hom q x)) = Sheaf.H.map ((Scheme.upperStarConstantSheafIso AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (pullback.fst h V.hom)).app (AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift (ZMod e)))).hom q (Sheaf.H.map (i.inv.app (Y.constantZMod e)) q (cohomologyMap g _ q x))

proof.text: Expand the defining comparison and use naturality of pullback on Ext and the universal section.
